narr: Convection during the early morning hours of the 23rd, centered across the Texas Panhandle, organized into a small mesoscale convective system (MCS) as it entered into portions of western Oklahoma by the mid-morning time frame. Severe wind gusts, a report of large hail and urban flash flooding were noted from western into central Oklahoma through the early afternoon hours.
ev: Social media video showing 1-3 feet of flowing water across the road near the intersection of West Rainey Street and West Main Street.
